origin.description: Alias of checkAtomic. Returns true, or a message, after testing whether the value is an atomic vector, including a matrix or array.
origin.usage: check_atomic(x, any.missing = TRUE, all.missing = TRUE, len = NULL, min.len = NULL, max.len = NULL, unique = FALSE, names = NULL)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Value under test. A Python int is an R integer and a Python float is an R double.

arguments.name: any.missing
arguments.text: When false, any missing value fails the check.

arguments.name: all.missing
arguments.text: When false, a completely missing value fails the check.

arguments.name: unique
arguments.text: When true, duplicate values fail the check.

arguments.name: names
arguments.text: Labels used when a combined assertion fails.

origin.details: Alias of checkAtomic. Returns true, or a message, after testing whether the value is an atomic vector, including a matrix or array.
origin.value: True, or a message describing the first failure.
